Agent Name: Probability_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The simulation code misimplemented the game mechanics for when the second or third piston fires. It failed to release the first-position ball, did not correctly advance the remaining balls (e.g., moving the third to first in the second-piston case and the second to first in the third-piston case), and even allowed the platform to exceed three balls. This flawed state update skewed ejection frequencies, leading to the incorrect conclusion (ball 2) instead of the correct answer (ball 3).
